title: This may take a while
description: Literally just a text on the world generation page that says "This may take a while"
body:
Adds a text durring the new world generation screen that says "This may take a while" 

Useful for big modpacks that take a long time to load a new world.

Helpful for new users to know their game didnt just freeze.

Report bugs / suggestions in my [Discord](https://discord.gg/vrekW2ZPbp)

Yes you can use this in your modpack as long as appropriate credits are given.
